shortDescription: Manage IP addresses on an interface on Solaris/illumos systems

options.name: address
options.description: Specifiies an IP address to configure in CIDR notation.

options.name: addrobj
options.description: Specifies an unique IP address on the system.

options.name: addrtype
options.description: Specifiies a type of IP address to configure.

options.name: state
options.description: Create/delete/enable/disable an IP address on the network interface.

options.name: temporary
options.description: Specifies that the configured IP address is temporary. Temporary IP addresses do not persist across reboots.

options.name: wait
options.description: Specifies the time in seconds we wait for obtaining address via DHCP.
